taskDescription: Locate the anchor function for the rewrite_token field in the console.log object whose action is route.rewrite after typing the route path, choosing the view policy, enabling preserve-scroll, and clicking Commit Route on the page. The same rewrite_token value is also written into the X-Route-Key header of a fetch request to the view prefetch endpoint and into the pushed route URL issued on commit. The anchor function is the first target-specific request-transform value constructor on the dynamic behavior chain: after delegated click routing, action routing, the commit gate, route material collection with page-context snapshot, tuple input preparation, asynchronous scheduling and runtime config selection, its function body itself constructs the target observable route rewrite value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, wrapping a return value, or writing the value to the console, fetch header or URL rewrite. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return generic utilities, event handlers, the full call chain, the final console sink, the fetch call site, or the URL rewrite call site.
